title: Message Transformation, Overflow Detection & Public API
description:
Implement cross-provider message transformation, context overflow detection, and public API re-exports from docs/plans/01-ai-core.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §10 (Cross-Provider Message Transformation), §11 (Context Overflow Detection), §14 (Public API Surface)

Key deliverables:
- TransformMessages: two-pass algorithm matching TS reference exactly
  - Pass 1: transform content (thinking block conversion, tool call ID normalization, error/aborted message skipping, signature stripping for cross-model)
  - Pass 2: insertSyntheticToolResults for orphaned tool calls (deterministic sorted iteration via sort.Strings on map keys)
- ToolCallIDNormalizer function type
- transformAssistantMessage: same-model passthrough vs cross-model conversion (thinking→text, strip signatures, normalize IDs)
- transformToolResult: ID remapping via idMap
- insertSyntheticToolResults: sorted map iteration for deterministic output, synthetic error results with "No result provided"
- ProviderError struct (Code, Message, StatusCode, Provider, RetryAfter)
- ProviderErrorCode constants (context_overflow, rate_limit, auth, server_error, unknown)
- IsContextOverflow: regex-based error message matching (14+ provider patterns) + silent overflow detection (usage.input > contextWindow)
- classifyErrorMessage, providerErrorFromMessage
- Public API surface: ai/ top-level package with type aliases and function vars re-exporting from internal/ai
- Unit tests: golden tests for TransformMessages (9 fixture files in testdata/transform/), table-driven for overflow patterns
- Test harness tests: P2 (TransformMessages idempotency with rapid), P6 (message count bound property), P8 (deterministic output, 100 iterations with orphaned tool calls), B3 (TransformMessages benchmark, target <1ms for 50-message conversation), F4 (overflow pattern fuzz)
- EventStream leak detection in test builds (URP §16.2): runtime.SetFinalizer warning for unclosed streams
- All tests must pass with -race flag

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/01-ai-core.md §10, §11, §14
- Test harness: docs/plans/01-ai-core-test-harness.md §1 (P2, P6, P8), §3 (F4), §5 (B3)
- Depends on: Core Types & EventStream (aiag-qkh.1), Provider Infrastructure (aiag-qkh.2) — uses Model type, Provider interface
